title: Banda’s Wife Blesses the Queens with Sons

blocks.text: The queens finally reach Banda’s wife, fall at her feet, and receive the blessing that each will bear a son within the year.
When the prophecy is fulfilled, named sons such as Abhraj Singh are born, confirming the blessing and closing the fertility episode in triumph.
Abhraj Singh is the concrete sign that the courtly petition succeeded and that Banda’s orbit now includes dynastic blessing as well as war.
